ThingDef.label: Sundrop
ThingDef.description: A sphere infused with golden energy directly from the sun. Despite the source of it's power, it is only warm to the touch.\n\nCan be used to revitialize the life force of certain Terraweapons, increasing the time before they wither away.

ThingDef.label: Deepsap
ThingDef.description:
A jar of refined, potent terrasap, named due to only being found within roots miles underground. Deepsap is required for more advanced and complex procedures involving Terratech, and is a very valuable resource to colonies that know how to utilize it. 

Like glowsap and brightsap, deepsap is not directly infused into other Terratech. Instead, it is most often used as a catalyst, taking an older creation and retroactively applying a newer, stronger iteration to it. 
Deepsap also allows Terrastructures to root deeper into the ground, allowing it to pull more nutrients and grow into a stronger structure. This is commonplace is more advanced structures, but can be applied to earlier Terrastructures too. Structures that utilize Deepsap will generally have "Deeproot" in their name. 
Deepsap is quite rare and can't be grown, but it's unique composition allows it to avoid expiry. This generally makes it a crafting component, instead of than a sap that needs to be maintained occasionally. 

Use cases: Allows matured weapons to be freely be replanted and regrown in 10% of original growth time (uses Deepsap). Creation of Deeproot Crucible Creation of Elderwood Chambertree Creation of Stellic Crucible Creates Deeproot Terravats

ThingDef.label: Sunsap
ThingDef.description:
A jar of terrasap containing stellar energies that were captured directly from the local sun. This sap can only be created during daylight hours; weather does not matter. 

Sunsap has no innate ability, but like Starsap it has immense energy potential. Those with sufficient Terratech knowledge can create Brightsap at an incredibly efficient ratio, alongside supporting very advanced Terrastructures. 

Current use cases: Conversion into Brightsap (1:10 ratio) Needed to grow Wild weaponry Upgrades organic weapons into their pinnacle form Highly valuable trade commodity with all EcoTech factions (Notes: Will have more use cases when Lithoid weapons are added!)

ThingDef.label: Starsap
ThingDef.description:
A jar of terrasap that contains stellar energies which are millions of years old. It can only be captured during the night, when the local solar energy isn't overwelming it. 

Starsap has no innate ability, but like Sunsap it has immense energy potential. Those with sufficient Terratech knowledge can create Brightsap at an incredibly efficient ratio. 

Current use cases: Conversion into Brightsap (1:10 ratio) Highly valuable trade commodity with all EcoTech factions (Notes: Will have many more uses case when Lithoid weapons are added!)

ThingDef.label: Archsap
ThingDef.description:
A jar of archsap, originating from sources unknown. People and colonies skilled with Ecotech can use this to replace the mundane sap of immature Terraweapons, caused the weapon to gain special traits that will persist throughout it's lifetime. 
Archsap requires a baseline weapon that has both sap and form at it's purest form; therefore, Archsap MUST be injected into unmodified matured weapons directly, making it's infusion method rather unique. Careful care, usage, and weapon selection is highly advised, due to it's extreme rarity, value, and effect of making it's host weapon semi-immortal. 

New traits: Infinite lifespan Flammability lowered by 50% Weapon HP increased by by 50%

ThingDef.label: Glowsap Tree Seed
ThingDef.description: A special seed containing vast amounts of energy and nutrients. Once planted on any soil that can support plants, the seed will immediately burst into vines and wood, taking root and forming into the biotic pattern of a Prima Turret.\n\nSurge Seeds expend their energy quite rapidly, deteriorating their condition. They will wither away if not planted within a few days after harvesting.
